game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway, rope walkways in the canopy: the fairy gardener must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway: rope walkways in the canopy
core_gameplay_loop: In Canopy Walkway, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round, bramble beasts strike the vine bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the vine bridge from bramble beasts in Canopy Walkway: keep the launch_timing meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: launch_timing drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how launch_timing changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bramble beasts in Canopy Walkway.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while launch_timing > 0.
